description: A tour booking service: tours with locations and dates, booking and payment through Stripe, reviews, notifications and user accounts with roles, plus a React front end, documented in Swagger.
role: Sole engineer: built the API and the front end
contributions: Built the API in Node.js, Express and MongoDB, over 102 commits
Built accounts: sign-up with email verification, login with refresh tokens, password reset and update, roles, and deactivation
Built tours with geospatial search: tours within a distance of a point, and distances from a point
Built aggregation reports: tour statistics, the five cheapest tours, and a monthly plan
Built booking and payment through Stripe, reviews, and notifications
Hardened it with Helmet, rate limiting and input sanitising; resized uploaded images with Sharp
Documented the API in Swagger and built a React front end for it
results: Geospatial search and aggregation reports on MongoDB
Rate limiting and input sanitising on every request

body.heading: What it does
paragraphs: Tours API runs a tour company's bookings. Tours carry their locations and dates, so customers can find tours within a distance of where they are and see how far each one is. Customers book and pay through Stripe and leave reviews afterwards; staff see statistics, the cheapest tours and a monthly plan of starts.

body.heading: Built carefully
paragraphs: Accounts use email verification, short-lived access tokens with refresh tokens, and roles. Every request passes through Helmet, a rate limiter and input sanitising before it reaches the database. Uploaded photos are resized with Sharp. Everything is documented in Swagger.

body.heading: Built with
paragraphs: Node.js, Express and MongoDB with Mongoose, JSON Web Tokens, Stripe, Nodemailer, Multer and Sharp, Swagger, and a React front end with Vite.
